name: rebalance_zero_target_full_close
description: Zero target with a held position closes the full position with no band test and no partial ratio. min_notional=1000 is deliberately larger than the 100 notional being closed: the zero-target full close is allowed below min_notional. absolute_band_nav=0.02 and partial_ratio=0.5 are explicit illustrative synthetic values (PENDING in the monograph).
derivation: equity=10000; AAA mult=1 mark=100, position 1. w_cur=1*100/10000=0.01. target=0 -> d=-0.01; zero target with qty != 0 -> trade the full d, band and partial ratio do not apply. qty=-0.01*10000/(1*100)=-1.0; step 1 keeps -1; notional=1*1*100=100 < min_notional=1000, but closing the entire position to a zero target is allowed (reduce to flat). orders={'AAA': -1.0}. Applying partial_ratio would trade -0.5 -> step 1 -> 0 (no trade); applying the band would block; both wrong here.
